# `grounded_villages.site` — root

Every type with its summary and every non-private constructor, method and constant. The
signature is the contract; read the source only when the summary is not enough.

Whole-village site selection (`docs/spec/domains/site.md`): grounded_villages.site.SiteScorer samples a candidate's footprint for height spread and water fraction over the pure grounded_villages.site.HeightSampler; grounded_villages.site.SiteSearch decides keep/shift/vanilla (grounded_villages.site.SiteDecision) and runs the bounded, deterministic search for a qualifying alternative when the vanilla start fails (`SITE-REQ-001`-004); grounded_villages.site.SiteStartHook is the live grounded_villages.hook.VillageStartHook a loader entrypoint registers into grounded_villages.hook.HookRegistry, adapting the pure logic above to and from grounded_villages.hook.TerrainSampler/BlockPos/StartDecision, and to whatever site.* grounded_villages.config.ConfigHolder currently holds.

### `interface HeightSampler` — `src/main/java/grounded_villages/site/HeightSampler.java`
The one pure abstraction SiteScorer and SiteSearch sample terrain through -- two plain-int queries per column, no Minecraft type anywhere (`04-architecture.md` ARCH-DEC-002: "pure functions over positions, heights, booleans").
- `int groundHeight(int x, int z)`
- `int surfaceHeight(int x, int z)`

### `record SiteCoordinate(int x, int z)` — `src/main/java/grounded_villages/site/SiteCoordinate.java`
A plain X/Z position, no Y and no Minecraft BlockPos (`04-architecture.md` ARCH-DEC-002: this package references no Minecraft type).

### `interface SiteDecision` — `src/main/java/grounded_villages/site/SiteDecision.java`
SiteSearch#evaluateStart's own pure result -- structurally the same three outcomes as grounded_villages.hook.StartDecision (keep/shift/vanilla, `domains/site.md`), kept as a separate type so this package references no Minecraft type (`04-architecture.md` ARCH-DEC-002: StartDecision.Shift carries a BlockPos, this carries a pure SiteCoordinate).
- `SiteDecision keep()`
- `SiteDecision shift(SiteCoordinate to)`
- `SiteDecision vanilla()`

    - **nested** `record Keep`

    - **nested** `record Shift(SiteCoordinate to)`

    - **nested** `record Vanilla`

### `record SiteScore(double heightSpread, double waterFraction, int sampleCount)` — `src/main/java/grounded_villages/site/SiteScore.java`
One candidate site's whole-footprint terrain measurement (`docs/spec/domains/site.md` §3): height spread (the 90th-minus-10th-percentile of sampled ground heights at OCEAN_FLOOR_WG) and water fraction (the share of sampled columns identified as water), plus how many columns SiteScorer#score actually sampled -- SiteScorer's own column cap (SITE-FAIL-003) can make this fewer than a naive step-8 grid over the full radius would sample, so a caller that wants the real cost reads it from here rather than recomputing it.
- `boolean qualifies(int maxHeightSpread, double maxWaterFraction)` — SITE-REQ-002: a candidate qualifies only if both thresholds hold -- <=, not <, since a site exactly at the configured ceiling is not itself "exceeding" it.

### `class SiteScorer` — `src/main/java/grounded_villages/site/SiteScorer.java`
Scores one candidate village site's whole footprint (`docs/spec/domains/site.md` §3, ticket GV-6 build item 1): a square grid centred on the candidate, #SAMPLE_STEP-block spacing, radius the caller's own choice -- the tier's max_distance once tiers exist (GV-8), or the jigsaw structure's own max_distance_from_center otherwise (what grounded_villages.mixin.village actually has in scope today, per the ticket's own build item 1: "the tier's max distance, or max_distance from the jigsaw structure, as the radius").
- `int SAMPLE_STEP` — Grid spacing, in blocks, at or below the column cap (ticket build item 1).
- `int MAX_SAMPLE_COLUMNS` — Upper bound on sampled columns per site -- SITE-FAIL-003's "bounded by the same config-driven sample count", applied here as a grid-density cap rather than a config key, since it is an implementation cost bound, not domain behaviour (`contracts/public-surface.md`: "the exact sampling grid ...
- `SiteScore score(HeightSampler sampler, int centerX, int centerZ, int radius)` — Scores the (2*radius+1) x (2*radius+1)-block square centred on (centerX, centerZ), at the grid step #effectiveStep(int) derives from radius.
- `int effectiveStep(int radius)` — The grid step actually used for radius: #SAMPLE_STEP unless that would put more than #MAX_SAMPLE_COLUMNS columns in the grid, in which case the step is coarsened (never refined below #SAMPLE_STEP) just enough to fit the cap.

### `class SiteSearch` — `src/main/java/grounded_villages/site/SiteSearch.java`
`domains/site.md` §3/§5: evaluate vanilla's own candidate start, and -- if it fails -- run a bounded, deterministic search for a qualifying alternative (`SITE-REQ-001`-004).
- `SiteDecision evaluateStart(HeightSampler sampler, int startX, int startZ, int footprintRadius, ConfigModel.Site config)` — SITE-REQ-001/002/004: score the vanilla start at (startX, startZ); keep it if it qualifies, otherwise search for a qualifying alternative within config's bounds and shift to the best-scoring one, or fall back to SiteDecision#vanilla() if the search exhausts its attempts (`SITE-FAIL-001`).
- `Optional<SiteCoordinate> searchAlternative(HeightSampler sampler, int originX, int originZ, int footprintRadius, ConfigModel.Site config)` — SITE-REQ-003/006: the bounded search itself, independent of whether (originX, originZ) was ever scored -- SITE-REQ-006 calls this directly on a site that already passed its own site-level check but produced too few surviving pieces, with no need to re-evaluate the origin first.
- `List<SiteCoordinate> spiralOffsets(int originX, int originZ, int step, int radius, int attempts)` — A fixed, deterministic spiral of up to attempts offsets from (originX, originZ): ring by ring outward at step-block spacing, the 8 #DIRECTIONS in a fixed order per ring, stopping once a ring's own axis distance exceeds radius (every later ring is strictly farther, so nothing more could qualify) or attempts offsets have been collected, whichever comes first.

### `class SiteStartHook` — `src/main/java/grounded_villages/site/SiteStartHook.java`
The live VillageStartHook a loader entrypoint registers into grounded_villages.hook.HookRegistry#setStartHook (ticket build item 3: GV-5 modeled Shift/Vanilla but shipped only VillageStartHook#ACCEPT_ALL; this is the first real implementation).
- `SiteStartHook INSTANCE` — Stateless; one shared instance registered by every loader entrypoint.
- `StartDecision onStart(GenerationContext context, BlockPos startPos, int maxDistanceFromCenter)`
